description: Export a creature or NPC as glTF with animations and its skin textures, headless. Beasts and monsters get their display skin and geosets. Humanoid NPCs (built from a player race model) get the right race and sex model, the NPC's hair, beard and similar geosets, the baked NPC skin and their worn armor (boots, robes, tabards and so on). Helms, shoulders and the NPC's weapons are written as separate models beside it, with the bone and position each one attaches to. Written to <outputDir>/creatures/.

displayId.description: Display id, when there is no creature id.

equipment.description: Apply worn armor and write helm, shoulder and weapon models. Default true.

flavor.description: Which installed client to read: mainline (retail), forever, classic or vanilla. Defaults to the first install found.

outputDir.description: Folder to write into (created if missing).

name: wow_creature_export
title: Export a creature or NPC with its skin
